scripts.dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src=fs.existsSync('assets/locatecursor')?'assets/locatecursor':(fs.existsSync('assets/compiled_raycast_swift/locatecursor')?'assets/compiled_raycast_swift/locatecursor':null); if(src){ try{fs.chmodSync(src, 0o755);}catch(e){} fs.mkdirSync('compiled_raycast_swift',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,'compiled_raycast_swift/locatecursor'); try{fs.chmodSync('compiled_raycast_swift/locatecursor', 0o755);}catch(e){} }" && ray develop
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p1='node_modules/@raycast/api/dist/utils/publish/copy-dir.js'; if(fs.existsSync(p1)){ fs.writeFileSync(p1, fs.readFileSync(p1,'utf8').replace('\"compiled_raycast_swift\",','')); } const p2='node_modules/@raycast/api/dist/commands/develop/index.js'; if(fs.existsSync(p2)){ let code=fs.readFileSync(p2,'utf8'); if(!code.includes('chmodSync')){ fs.writeFileSync(p2, code.replace('$m.existsSync(\"assets\")&&$m.cpSync(\"assets\",Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"assets\"),{recursive:!0});', '$m.existsSync(\"assets\")&&$m.cpSync(\"assets\",Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"assets\"),{recursive:!0}),$m.rmSync(Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"compiled_raycast_swift\"),{recursive:!0,force:!0}),$m.existsSync(Gd.join(\"assets\",\"compiled_raycast_swift\"))&&$m.cpSync(Gd.join(\"assets\",\"compiled_raycast_swift\"),Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"compiled_raycast_swift\"),{recursive:!0,force:!0});$m.existsSync(Gd.join(\"assets\",\"locatecursor\"))&&($m.mkdirSync(Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"compiled_raycast_swift\"),{recursive:!0}),$m.copyFileSync(Gd.join(\"assets\",\"locatecursor\"),Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"compiled_raycast_swift\",\"locatecursor\")));try{$m.chmodSync(Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"assets\",\"locatecursor\"),0o755)}catch(e){};try{$m.chmodSync(Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"assets\",\"compiled_raycast_swift\",\"locatecursor\"),0o755)}catch(e){};try{$m.chmodSync(Gd.join(u.outputDir,\"compiled_raycast_swift\",\"locatecursor\"),0o755)}catch(e){};')); } }"
